description: On a `tg --tag decision …` send, runs the decision-request-discipline self-check: parses (shlex, not raw-match) the message body and, if it is missing structural markers (Context / Options / Recommendation), emits an exit-0 ADVISORY naming what's absent. ADVISORY ONLY — never blocks; a malformed decision request must stay sendable. on_error=open: a formatting reminder, not a boundary. Silence with ALLOW_RAW_DECISION_REQUEST=1 or `# decision-request-ok: <reason>`.
